howToPlay.title: How To Play
howToPlay.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your first case.

1.title: Pick a Case
1.description: Choose the case you want to play and read through its details before you begin.

2.title: Choose Player Count
2.description: The game is played with 3 to 8 players. Pick the number that fits your group.

3.title: Everyone Gets a Character
3.description: Each player receives a secret character with their own private information. Don't reveal your role to anyone.

4.title: Read What You Know
4.description: Every character has things they know, things they're hiding, and relationships to the other characters. Pay attention to every detail.

5.title: Start Investigating
5.description: Discuss the events, question each other, and compare what you each know. Not everything will be clear right away.

6.title: Look for Contradictions
6.description: Some clues will confirm what someone said — others might reveal a contradiction or a hidden secret.

7.title: Name a Suspect
7.description: Once the investigation is over, every player picks who they think the killer is.

8.title: Reveal the Truth
8.description: At the end, you'll find out who the real killer was and see if your suspicions were right.

randomNotice.label: Important
randomNotice.body: The killer can change every time you play the same case, so never assume the same person is the killer twice.

about.title: About The Game
about.subtitle: Information about DOSSIER
about.description1: DOSSIER is a group investigation game where you and your friends live through a mysterious case and try to reach the truth.
about.description2: Every case has characters, secrets, clues, and details that can change the course of the investigation.
about.description3: The catch? You'll never know everything... and not everyone is telling the truth.
about.goalBody: Gather information, connect the clues, spot the contradictions, and try to figure out who the killer is before the truth reveals itself.
about.tagline: Choose a Case. Trust No One.
